The week, in one breath

142 points, and the Pirates still aren't in first

The Pirates of the CaribBijan won the week's shootout, 142.12–133.18 over The CMC, and now own the most points in the league — 901.24 — from fifth place at 4–3. The CMC's 133.18 goes down as the most points ever scored in a loss in this league. Mommas Home <3 beat Honk Dawgs 113.72–94.78 to move to 6–1 and sole possession of first, Tony Pollard hung 35.0 in the week's biggest rout, and two starting defenses finished below zero.

Game Stories

Every matchup gets a case file, a culprit and one completely imagined quote.
Shootout

275 points of offense, one loser with 133

Pirates of the CaribBijan def. The CMC | 142.12 – 133.18

Pirates · 4–3BY 8.94CMC · 3–4

Jaxon Smith-Njigba (26.8), Jameson Williams (23.6) and Omar Cooper Jr. (20.0) gave the Pirates three starters over 20 and the week's high score, 142.12. The win lifts the Pirates to a league-best 901.24 points for on the season — and to fifth place, because this league's standings are a crime scene.

The CMC did almost nothing wrong: Dak Prescott (23.28), Trey McBride (22.1) and Luther Burden III (21.7) all cleared 21. The total, 133.18, would have beaten every other team in the league this week. Instead it is the most points ever scored in a loss in Big Ballers history. Somebody frame the box score and hang it in a museum of pain.

“We scored 133 and lost. I'm not angry, I'm just framing it.”Imagined postgame quote · The CMC
Blowout

Pollard scores a third of a kingdom

Kings of New York def. J9hunna | 105.62 – 77.76

Kings · 5–2BY 27.86J9 · 4–3

Tony Pollard scored 35.0 points. The Kings of New York scored 105.62. One running back personally produced a third of a 27.86-point rout, with Caleb Williams (22.12) and Amon-Ra St. Brown (19.7) playing the supporting cast. The Kings even absorbed Jaylin Noel's 0.7 without blinking.

J9hunna's side of the ledger is a reading of the charges: 77.76 points, the lowest score of the week, with no starter above Jordan Love's 17.96. Dameon Pierce added 11.3, Christian Watson 8.2, and the New York Jets defense — added this week — posted 1.0. The 4–3 record says contender. Sunday said otherwise.

“Pollard gets two game balls. He earned the second one carrying us.”Imagined postgame quote · Kings of New York
First Place

Mommas wins with a zero in the lineup

Mommas Home <3 def. Honk Dawgs | 113.72 – 94.78

Mommas · 6–1BY 18.94Honk · 5–2

Malik Willis (26.02), Javonte Williams (21.5) and Puka Nacua (17.8) carried Mommas Home <3 to 113.72 and sole possession of first place at 6–1 — a win so comfortable it survived Tyjae Spears scoring exactly 0.0 in a starting spot. First place, short-handed, unbothered.

Honk Dawgs got the week's second-best quarterback score from Joe Burrow (28.88) and 18.6 from Cam Skattebo — and then started a Philadelphia defense that scored −4.0. Negative four. Burrow's heroics bought a ticket to a game his own defense had already set on fire. Honk falls to 5–2, and the Fraud Watch file grows thicker. See inside.

“We spotted them a running back and still won by 19. Next question.”Imagined postgame quote · Mommas Home <3
Chaos

132 points, a −3 defense, and the league's worst schedule

Steven diggs def. dellnuts | 132.4 – 117.32

Steven · 2–5BY 15.08dellnuts · 2–5

Zay Flowers (23.7), Kirk Cousins (20.4) and KC Concepcion Jr. (19.2) built Steven diggs' 132.4 — the week's second-highest winning score — and it was nearly sabotaged from inside the house: the Carolina defense Steven diggs started scored −3.0. Winning by 15.08 with a negative starter is either depth or arson insurance paying out.

dellnuts made it a game: Bucky Irving (23.5), Emanuel Wilson (18.0) and Braelon Allen (16.4) all produced, and 117.32 was the sixth-best score posted all week. It still lost by 15.08. The loss drops dellnuts to 2–5. Steven diggs also climbs to 2–5 — while still owning the league's most points against, 992.82. Every week is a shootout when your defense is a rumor.

“Our defense scored negative three and we won by fifteen. I understand nothing.”Imagined postgame quote · Steven diggs
Game Recap

Romo keeps pace, Everybody Hurts keeps hurting

Romo's Rum Runner def. Everybody Hurts | 120.32 – 109.06

Romo · 5–2BY 11.26Hurts · 1–6

Tee Higgins (23.8) and Rhamondre Stevenson (20.0) did the heavy lifting for Romo's Rum Runner, with Jahmyr Gibbs (14.8) in support, in a 120.32–109.06 win that keeps Romo at 5–2 with the league's second-most points for, 870.08. No drama, no collapse, just a contender handling its schedule.

Everybody Hurts actually found a pulse: waiver add Caleb Douglas scored 20.0 in his first week on the roster, Jonathan Taylor added 18.0 and Josh Jacobs 17.6. It still wasn't enough — Juwan Johnson's 1.2 at tight end saw to that — and the loss drops Everybody Hurts to 1–6, alone in the basement with 873.64 points against.

“Our best player this week was a guy we picked up on Tuesday. That's the season.”Imagined postgame quote · Everybody Hurts
Game Recap

Maye's 28.44 buys lexxyfour absolutely nothing

lotes def. lexxyfour | 119.12 – 100.94

lotes · 3–4BY 18.18lexxy · 2–5

Quinshon Judkins (22.9), CeeDee Lamb (21.9) and Blake Corum (16.6) gave lotes three starters above 16 in a 119.12–100.94 win — and lotes did it while its own New York Giants defense scored 1.0. The win moves lotes to 3–4 despite owning the league's fewest points for, 667.34. Winning ugly is still winning.

lexxyfour's Drake Maye scored 28.44, the third-best starter performance of the week, and Kyren Williams (17.1) and Ja'Marr Chase (14.7) came along — and lexxyfour still lost by 18.18 to fall to 2–5. A near-29-point quarterback game, spent entirely on a loss. The quarterback is not the problem in lexxyfour. Everything after him might be.

“Maye for MVP of games we lose. It's a very specific trophy case.”Imagined postgame quote · lexxyfour
Fraud Watch · Case file

Honk Dawgs

5–2, fourth place — and an offense that scores like a 2–5 team. An inquiry.

The record says contender: 5–2, fourth place. The points say something else entirely. Honk Dawgs have scored 757.62 points all season — fewer than Steven diggs (767.78) and lexxyfour (766.72), two teams sitting at 2–5. What Honk owns is the league's softest landing spot: 623.18 points against, the fewest any team has faced, by a wide and widening margin.

Week 7 was the schedule finally sending an invoice. Joe Burrow scored 28.88 — the week's second-best starter — and Honk still lost by 18.94, because the starting Philadelphia defense posted −4.0. When the opponents stop cooperating, this is what the Dawgs look like: one great quarterback, one arsonist defense, and a points-for column that belongs in the bottom half of the table.

Under Investigation

Fraud Watch verdict: 5–2 on the softest schedule in the league. The record is real. So is the 623.18.

Transactions

Two trades, then the usual waiver-wire churn.
Everybody HurtsAdds Baker Mayfield (QB) and Caleb Douglas (WR); drops Michael Penix Jr. and Samaje Perine. Douglas immediately scored 20.0 — the best debut on this page. Also adds the Tennessee defense and drops the Indianapolis defense and Dontayvion Wicks.
Steven diggsAdds J.J. McCarthy (QB) and Darnell Washington (TE) — and churns Geno Smith and Tanner McKee out and back in within the same week. Also adds Seth McGowan (RB) and the Carolina defense (started it: −3.0), and drops Zonovan Knight, then adds him back too. The carousel is the strategy.
lexxyfourAdds the New England defense and Brandin Cooks (WR); drops Sam Darnold.
Kings of New YorkAdds Jaylin Noel (WR) and Ryan Flournoy (WR); drops Rashid Shaheed and Rashod Bateman. Noel's first week as a King: 0.7 points, in a 27.86-point win.
Mommas Home <3Adds Pat Freiermuth (TE); drops Oronde Gadsden.
The CMCAdds Michael Mayer (TE) and Konata Mumpfield (WR); drops Courtland Sutton.
J9hunnaAdds the New York Jets defense. It scored 1.0. The name of the team remains a promise, not a result.
dellnutsAdds Jordan Watkins (WR); drops MarShawn Lloyd.
Pirates of the CaribBijanAdds Antonio Williams (WR); drops Roschon Johnson — the same Roschon Johnson who changed hands in the Roschon-for-Kaelon trade with The CMC on this week's wire. Yes, both. No, we don't know either.
